items.title: Tamil Nadu library scam: DVAC arrests proprietor of Akal Vizhakku Publishers R Mohan
items.summary: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC) has arrested R Mohan, proprietor of Akal Vizhakku Publishers and Phoenix Publications on Monday, November 16, over irregularities in procuring books for public libraries, including the Periyar Arivulagam Library in Coimbatore. In the First Information Report (FIR), registered on November 15, the agency said that books were created under fictitious author names, contained misleading information and were procured through collusion between the publisher and government officials. Besides Mohan, the FIR also names unidentified officials from the Directorate of Public Libraries, Anna Centenary Library in Chennai and Periyar Arivulagam Library in Coimbatore. The irregularities resulted in payments totalling more than Rs 1.74 crore to two publishing firms, the agency said. The irregularities came to light after writer Perumal Murugan flagged inaccuracies and fabricated historical and literary references in books stocked at the newly inaugurated Periyar Arivulagam Library in Coimbatore.
